title.zh: 对第590号法案作如下修正：规定治安法官在省会进行的刑事犯罪初步调查费用，即使犯罪行为发生在其他市镇，也应由犯罪行为发生地的市镇承担的法案
title.en: AN ACT SO AMENDING ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND NINETY AS TO PROVIDE THAT THE EXPENSES OF PRELIMINARY INVESTIGATIONS FOR CRIMINAL OFFENSES BY JUSTICES OF THE PEACE, WHEN HELD AT THE CAPITAL OF THE PROVINCE, ALTHOUGH THE OFFENSES WERE COMMITTED IN OTHER MUNICIPALITIES, SHALL BE PAID BY THE MUNICIPALITIES IN WHICH THE OFFENSES WERE COMMITTED.
title.orig: AN ACT SO AMENDING ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND NINETY AS TO PROVIDE THAT THE EXPENSES OF PRELIMINARY INVESTIGATIONS FOR CRIMINAL OFFENSES BY JUSTICES OF THE PEACE, WHEN HELD AT THE CAPITAL OF THE PROVINCE, ALTHOUGH THE OFFENSES WERE COMMITTED IN OTHER MUNICIPALITIES, SHALL BE PAID BY THE MUNICIPALITIES IN WHICH THE OFFENSES WERE COMMITTED.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 590 để quy định chi phí điều tra sơ bộ các tội hình sự do Thẩm phán Hòa giải tiến hành tại thủ phủ tỉnh sẽ do các thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh nơi xảy ra tội phạm chi trả
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่590เพื่อกำหนดว่าค่าใช้จ่ายในการสอบสวนเบื้องต้นสำหรับความผิดทางอาญาโดยผู้พิพากษาสันติราษฎร์เมื่อดำเนินการที่เมืองหลวงของจังหวัดแม้ว่าความผิดจะเกิดขึ้นในอำเภออื่นๆนั้นให้จ่ายโดยอำเภอที่ความผิดนั้นเกิดขึ้น
title.id: Undang-Undang yang Mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 590 agar Menyediakan bahwa Biaya Penyelidikan Awal untuk Tindak Pidana oleh Hakim Perdamaian yang Dilakukan di Ibu Kota Provinsi, Meskipun Tindak Pidana Dilakukan di Kotamadya Lain, Harus Dibayar oleh Kotamadya Tempat Tindak Pidana Tersebut Dilakukan
title.ms: Akta yang mengubah Akta Nombor 590 bagi menyediakan bahawa perbelanjaan siasatan awal bagi kesalahan jenayah oleh Hakim Perdamaian apabila dijalankan di ibu kota wilayah walaupun kesalahan itu dilakukan di perbandaran lain akan ditanggung oleh perbandaran tempat kesalahan itu dilakukan

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Five hundred and ninety, entitled "An Act so an lending Act
Numbered One hundred and ninety-four, relating to preliminary investigations of criminal offenses by
justices of the peace, and portions oil General Orders, Numbered Fifty-eight, as to authorize justices of the
peace in the capitals of provinces to hold preliminary investigations in regard to offenses alleged to have
been committed in any portion oil the province," is hereby amended by adding at the end thereof the
following words: "Provided, however, That the expense of such preliminary investigation shall be paid by
the municipality in which, the offense was committed, in the same manner as though the preliminary
investigation had been conducted in such municipality."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 28, 1904.
